tiers.name: C# Style Tiers
tiers.summary: Fidelity and presentation tiers used to group C# style choices.

properties.summary: Whether every choice in the tier may change emitted IL bytes.

choices.name: Use IL slot local names
choices.summary: Keep V_index for a local that has no PDB source name instead of synthesizing a readable name.

choices.name: Prefer approximate PDB local names
choices.summary: When exact scoped identity cannot be represented, use a deterministic collision-resolved name associated with the physical PDB slot; fidelity remains Partial.

choices.name: Wrap long boolean chains
choices.summary: Break a long short-circuit &&/|| chain across lines instead of one very wide line (whitespace only).

choices.name: Keep one-liners on one line
choices.summary: Suppress the always-on width wrappers (long fluent chains and long member signatures) so a wide construct stays on a single physical line instead of wrapping (whitespace only).

choices.name: Wrap expression-body arrow
choices.summary: Wrap the => of an expression-bodied member or accessor onto the next line instead of keeping it on the declaration line (whitespace only).

choices.name: Qualify field access with this.
choices.summary: Render this. on an instance field even where the bare name is unambiguous (IL-identical).

choices.name: Qualify property access with this.
choices.summary: Render this. on an instance property even where the bare name is unambiguous (IL-identical).

choices.name: Qualify method access with this.
choices.summary: Render this. on an instance method call even where the bare name is unambiguous (IL-identical).

choices.name: Qualify event access with this.
choices.summary: Render this. on an instance event even where the bare name is unambiguous (IL-identical).

choices.name: Guarded boolean return style · Conditional expression (ternary)
choices.summary: How to render a declined guarded boolean return: the byte-faithful flat if/return (default), the oracle-preferred ternary return c ? A : B; (byte-divergent), or the compact short-circuit "bool hack" (byte-divergent, not oracle-endorsed).

choices.name: Guarded boolean return style · Branchless "bool hack"
choices.summary: How to render a declined guarded boolean return: the byte-faithful flat if/return (default), the oracle-preferred ternary return c ? A : B; (byte-divergent), or the compact short-circuit "bool hack" (byte-divergent, not oracle-endorsed).

choices.name: var vs. explicit type · var for built-in types
choices.summary: When to spell a local declaration with var instead of its explicit type: never (explicit, the default), for built-in types, when the type is apparent from the initializer, and/or elsewhere. Byte-neutral; the three var categories are independent, matching the csharp_style_var_* editorconfig keys.

choices.name: var vs. explicit type · var when the type is apparent
choices.summary: When to spell a local declaration with var instead of its explicit type: never (explicit, the default), for built-in types, when the type is apparent from the initializer, and/or elsewhere. Byte-neutral; the three var categories are independent, matching the csharp_style_var_* editorconfig keys.

choices.name: var vs. explicit type · var elsewhere
choices.summary: When to spell a local declaration with var instead of its explicit type: never (explicit, the default), for built-in types, when the type is apparent from the initializer, and/or elsewhere. Byte-neutral; the three var categories are independent, matching the csharp_style_var_* editorconfig keys.

choices.name: Use explicit object creation
choices.summary: Keep the constructed type in new T(...) instead of shortening to target-typed new(...) where the assignment target already supplies it.

choices.name: Shared enum case-label order
choices.summary: Order named enum labels that share one switch body alphabetically (default) or by recovered numeric value. Byte-neutral; mixed or unnamed labels keep value order.

choices.name: Use explicit long literal casts
choices.summary: Render compiler-shaped long constants as explicit (long)N casts instead of the default terse spelling: NL when a marker is required, or bare N when a binary sibling fixes long promotion. Genuine ldc.i8 sources keep their current spelling.

Formatting.name: Formatting
Formatting.summary: Layout only — whitespace and line breaks. The code itself is unchanged, and compiles to identical IL.

Spelling.name: Spelling
Spelling.summary: An equally faithful way to spell the same code, such as qualifying a member with this or writing var. Compiles to identical IL.

Synthesis.name: Local naming
Synthesis.summary: Readable or approximate display names for locals. Compiles to identical IL, but the selected names may not represent exact source identity.

Lens.name: Style lenses
Lens.summary: Keeps what the code does, but not the exact bytes: this rendering recompiles to different IL than the shipped output, so it is excluded from byte-level fidelity checking.
